message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts.

Facts: Two defendants: 邓某 and 付武1某. They accepted bribes to facilitate illegal high school exam registration for non-eligible candidates. They also forged official documents (school and police station seals) to create false academic and household registration certificates. So crimes: (1) Acceptance of bribes (贿赂罪) – specifically, accepting bribes (受贿). (2) Illegal admission of students (招收学生徇私舞弊罪) – which is a specific crime under Chinese law: “招收学生徇私舞弊罪” (illegal admission of students). (3) Forgery of state documents (伪造国家机关公文罪) – forging official seals and documents.

The prosecution says should be charged with “××、招收学生徇私舞弊罪” and also “伪造国家机关公文罪”. So likely the answer includes three crimes: 受贿罪; 招收学生徇私舞弊罪; 伪造国家机关公文罪.
